name: COURAGE
question: Does adding vibegron to an α-blocker, with or without a 5α-reductase inhibitor, improve persistent overactive bladder symptoms in men treated for BPH?

arms.label: Vibegron 75 mg once daily added to an α-blocker with or without a 5α-reductase inhibitor
matched placebo added to an α-blocker with or without a 5α-reductase inhibitor

design.population: 1,105 men aged 45 years or older with at least 8 micturitions and 3 urgency episodes daily despite a stable α-blocker, with or without a 5α-reductase inhibitor, for BPH.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized superiority trial
design.locator: PMC12721610 Methods and Results, Patients; arm sizes from ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03902080 participant flow

verdictNote: Both coprimary endpoints met and all secondary endpoints improved; retention occurred in under 1% of either arm.
takeaway: In 1,105 men with persistent overactive bladder symptoms despite an α-blocker for BPH, adding vibegron 75 mg reduced daily micturitions and urgency episodes more than placebo at 12 weeks (differences −0.74 and −0.95 per day); urinary retention occurred in under 1% of either arm.

harms.label: Any treatment-emergent adverse event
harms.locator: PMC12721610 (full text), Table 2; safety analysis set
harms.note: Safety set: 553 vibegron (including 2 placebo-assigned participants who took vibegron) and 551 placebo. Treatment-related events: 55 (9.9%) versus 52 (9.4%).

harms.label: Serious treatment-emergent adverse events
harms.note: No serious event was judged treatment related by the investigator; no deaths.

harms.label: Hypertension
harms.note: Preexisting hypertension was present in 64.9% (vibegron) and 66.6% (placebo) of the full analysis set.

harms.label: Urinary retention (adverse event of special interest)
harms.note: Retention required catheterization with postvoid residual of at least 300 mL, or at least 200 mL with symptoms. Retention or increased residual urine volume occurred in under 1% of either arm. Men with prior retention or Qmax under 5 mL/s were excluded.

harms.label: Neoplasms
harms.note: All diagnosed within 80 days of starting study drug; none judged treatment related. Basal cell carcinoma was the only type in more than 1 participant.

delivery.value: 82 sites in North America and Europe; March 7, 2019 to June 15, 2023

delivery.label: Trial periods
delivery.value: Up to 5-week screening, 2-week single-blind placebo run-in, 24-week double-blind treatment; optional 28-week extension

delivery.label: Randomized, dosed and completed
delivery.value: 1,105 randomized; 1,104 received at least 1 dose; 965 (87.3%) completed

delivery.label: Concurrent 5α-reductase inhibitor with α-blocker

delivery.note: All men took an α-blocker for at least 3 months before screening; a 5α-reductase inhibitor was optional (at least 6 months).

delivery.label: Baseline daily micturitions, median
delivery.note: Baseline median daily urgency episodes 9.0 (vibegron) versus 9.3 (placebo).

harms.note: Clinically significant postvoid residual increase not meeting the retention definition.
